unresolved_candidates.source_text: The foundation was uncovered, and she was going up, and her slave women were being led away like doves murmuring in their hearts.
unresolved_candidates.reason: The supplied Ezekiel unit speaks of survivors on the mountains and says God will kill them in their injustices. It contains no expected dove-mourning comparison, so the proposed imagery link is not retained. The separately read Isaiah prayer actually supplies a dove murmuring.

target_units.text: Their survivors will be saved and be on the mountains; I will kill them all, each in his injustices.
